text: Program Description Brief Introduction With remarkable expansion of the number of foreign students coming to the university, GDUT provides a wide range of Chinese language programs on various levels of learning and training. Students are expected to improve Chinese proficiency at the end of each program with a closer look into the tradition and custom, to communicate with native Chinese, and to obtain sufficient skills and knowledge in the areas of HSK Tests. In addition, special-designed course work tailored to the needs of certain students may also be provided and arranged. Teaching Objective To acquaint students with the essentials of Chinese language, including consonants, vowels, intonation, pronunciation, Chinese character writing, commonly used vocabulary and basic grammar. To develop student's ability in listening, speaking, writing and translating, and prepare students both linguistically and culturally for daily contact with Chinese people. To promote the ability to successfully pass the HSK Test. Courses and Candidates Class Candidates Compulsory Courses Elective Courses Elementary Chinese(1) for beginners Basic Chinese intensive reading; Chinese listening comprehension for beginners; basic Chinese reading; Chinese Characters; Basic oral Chinese, etc. Chinese Painting, Chinese Calligraphy, Chinese folk songs and music, Martial Arts, Chinese History and Geography, Survey of China, Computerized Information Processing, Cantonese, etc. Elementary Chinese(2) for students who have studied Chinese language for 4-6 months, or as an equivalent to HSK Grade 2; Intermediate Chinese(1) for students who have studied Chinese language for 10-12 months, or as an equivalent to HSK Grade 3; Intermediate Chinese intensive reading, Intermediate Chinese extensive reading, Intermediate spoken Chinese, basic Chinese writing. Chinese grammar, etc. Intermediate Chinese(2) for students who have studied Chinese language for 16-18 months, or as an equivalent to HSK Grade 4; Advanced Chinese(1) for students who have studied Chinese language for 2 years, or as an equivalent to the level of HSK Grade 5; Advanced Chinese (1) is equivalent to the level of the third academic year of a four year study. Advanced Chinese, Audio-Visual Chinese, Advanced Chinese extensive reading, Survey of China, An Introduction to Chinese culture, Business Chinese, etc. Advanced Chinese(2) for students who have studied Chinese language for 2 years, or as an equivalent to the level of HSK Grade 6; Advanced Chinese (1) is equivalent to the level of the fourth academic year of a four year study. Class Time Morning:8:30-12:00, Afternoon:13:30-16:30(Monday-Friday). Notes : 1) The long-term class students should attend a class-dividing test. We have examinations twice a semester, and the test result will decide which class you are in. 2) If students complete their lessons within the period of study, certificate will be granted. 3) Students have the right to choose the classes and courses according to their own interest and language levels. 4)Notes For students who applied within one month or after the starting date: -If you are a beginner, you may need to wait until the university gets enough students to open a beginner class(there will be uncertainties). -If you have learned Chinese before, you might be able to come to China and study with the current class directly. -If you want one-semester program only but are only able to come to China when there is a very short time left, you are advised to switch to 1 1-year program. If you insist on only want one-semester program and are ok with just learn for the remaining time, it is also ok.
